trace.content:
You write job advertisements for a South African recruitment platform. You receive a hiring brief and return one advertisement as structured JSON.

The only source of facts is the brief. This rule is absolute:
- Every statement about the employer, pay, benefits, location, work mode, team, reporting line, process, dates or legal status must appear in the brief. If the brief does not state it, leave the field empty. Never invent a benefit, a salary, a team size, a closing date, a contact, or an equity, privacy or accessibility statement.
- You may rephrase, reorder, split and tighten the brief's content. You may not add facts.
- If the brief is thin, write a shorter ad. A short true ad beats a long padded one.

Write for the candidate reading on a phone:
- Title: the plain occupation name, under 60 characters, no internal grade codes, no words like rockstar or ninja.
- 300–650 words in total. Sentences under 25 words. Short paragraphs; bullets for duties, requirements and benefits.
- Address the reader as "you". Never write "the ideal candidate", "the successful applicant" or "he/she".
- If the brief gives a purpose or success measures, use them to tell the reader what they will own and what good looks like. If a requirement carries "needed because", you may state that reason.
- Each responsibility bullet names a specific activity and its object, and where the brief allows, its scale, audience or how success is measured. Not "support the team"; rather "reconcile 40 supplier statements each month and resolve queries with buyers".
- Three to six must-have requirements, each one needed by a duty you listed. Everything else goes under nice-to-have. Do not add years-of-experience figures the brief did not give.
- If pay is given, state it exactly, with what determines placement in the range if the brief says so.
- Say who the person reports to and the team size only if the brief gives them. Say remote, hybrid or on-site only if the brief does.
- Plain language. No "fast-paced", "work hard play hard", "self-starter", "rockstar", "passionate", "competitive salary", "market-related".
- Neutral wording: avoid aggressive, dominant, competitive, fearless and similar masculine-coded adjectives; avoid "young", "energetic", "recent graduate", "native speaker", "able-bodied", age ranges, and anything about family status, religion or health. State a requirement only if the duties need it.
- Include the employer's equity, POPIA and accessibility statements verbatim when the brief provides them; otherwise leave those fields empty.
- Include application steps, closing date and contact only as given. If the brief says the ad is published on a job board with its own Apply button, leave the contact field empty.

Output: the JSON structure requested, with empty strings, 0 or "unspecified" for anything the brief does not provide.

Title: Lead Technology
Company: Absa Group
About the company: Empowering Africa’s tomorrow, together…one story at a time. With over 100 years of rich history and strongly positioned as a local bank with regional and international expertise, a career with our family offers the opportunity to be part of this exciting growth journey, to reset our future and shape our destiny as a proudly African group.
Purpose of the role: Lead the agile solution design, deployment & ongoing optimization & evolution of enterprise wide technology products and services (full stack engineering & ownership / control) in low complexity environments.
Responsibilities (hiring manager's notes):
  - Work with the CIO & business product owners to define the product & technical strategy (Full Stack – End to End)
  - Act as the single point of partnership & assume responsibility for managing the senior business interface (product owner) relationship
  - Assume one stop shop accountability for the delivery of the product & solutions (risk cannot be outsourced to vendors)
  - Apply design thinking practices to deliver architecturally sound technical product & service solutions (and explain / guide / coach others on this architecture holistically and technically)
  - Lead & facilitate the design of the product & or service solution blueprints aligned to the organization strategy (Short, Medium & Long Term)
  - Collaborate across the tech value chain (CSO, CTO, etc.) to guide the business on the appropriate technical solution (cost to value) & the range of strategic technical choices to be made
  - Lead the detailed scoping, prioritisation & integration planning for the design & deployment of products & services with & across multiple stakeholder groups (Front End, Back End & Integration) – (aligned to solution blueprints)
  - Meaningfully contribute & ensure solutions align to the design & direction of the Group Architecture standards, principles, preferences & practices. Short term deployment must align to strategic long term delivery.
  - Meaningfully contribute & ensure solutions align to the design and direction of the Group Infrastructure standards and practices e.g. OLA’s, IAAS, PAAS, SAAS, Containerisation etc.
  - Strategically & operationally monitor the performance of products and services (all applications) – ensuring ongoing optimization & cost to value for our businesses (think bank wide)
  - Leverage the required expert level (own) skill & knowledge in architecture & Infrastructure, design and manage all development & development practices & outputs across squads (apply knowledge on virtualization, containerization, automation, storage & serverless technologies (e.g. AWS, Azure, Google, & on prem-Cloud, etc.)
  - Ensure the most optimal design & deployment of technical products and services in the organization (via pipeline – not manually)
  - Design & Implement Automation Testing, Continuous Integration & Continuous Delivery Strategies & frameworks across squads for effective solution development & deployment (understand and apply expert knowledge in e.g. Kubernetes, Jenkins, TeamCity, Arifactory, MS Powershell, Collaborative Lifecycle Management (CLM) Tools, APM Tools (e.g. NewRelic & Splunk) etc.
  - Ensure solution designs deliver on the key technical principles of: self-service, repeatability, testability, scalability & resilience
  - Guide code development practices and processes through an understanding of complex concepts and developmental practices such as threading, parallel processing, asynchronous programming, domain driven design, lambdas etc. & coding language expertise (e.g. Java, C++, Groovy, Python, Bash, Perl, Ruby etc.)
  - Guide & ensure the delivery of quality development (code) based on own experience in developing across a range of applications including but not limited to: server side, client side, web (SOAP, REST, JSON), socket based programming, batch & real time, building architectural patterns, security / security domains
  - Effectively manage the DevOps pipeline & associated releases for maximum customer impact & minimum business risk
  - Manage the maintenance & optimization of applications, products & services as a ‘way of doing things / culture’ within the development teams. You are fully accountable for the longevity of applications aligned to Group Architectural practices.
  - Coach & Mentor senior developers across squads on the technical competencies to effectively deliver on DevOps solutions (see Dev competency model in skills & competencies section). To do this, display proficiency in the Senior level competency requirements.
  - With fluency in the deployment of agile methodologies, resource & manage the appropriate number and nature (skill & capability) of squad based teams to execute on both Run & Change elements of delivery
  - Work in collaboration with transformation & change teams for effective resourcing and delivery management of various programmes at all levels (SI, BU etc.)
  - Ensure agile practices are implemented and sustained for effective delivery to business e.g. RETRO’s etc.
  - Positively & proactively manage product owner relationships including building product owner technical capability to enable balanced & best fit decision making
  - Proactively engage with & partner CTO, CSO, SE, Risk and broader enablement functions to drive alignment & leading practice in technology design & deployment
  - Set & Cascade Product & Service direction across squads
  - Proactively attract, recruit, develop, retain, reward & deploy a diverse resource base aligned to an ever evolving tech environment (ahead of demand)
  - Build a high performance team environment through self-directed teams by driving performance management & measurement that is aligned with agile working practices (including daily, weekly, etc. sprint routines, regular & honest feedback etc.)
  - Accountable for the right people in the right teams to deliver on our tech strategy (always!)
  - Leverage coaching techniques in all squad related activity to drive a higher quality design and deployment of technical products and services
  - Carry the ‘one stop shop’ accountability for all risk associated with technical decision making (from ideation to deployment)
  - Manage & Apply the organization risk & governance frameworks
  - Ensure decisions on infrastructure & product design are aligned to chapter & guild guidelines & are sustainable for the enterprise
  - Proactively involve / engage chapter & guild leads in product design & infrastructure decision making, applying an enterprise wide lens to product & service development
  - Manage all vendor selection processes & take full accountability for all related commercial impact
  - Negotiate best fit contracts for the organization at an enterprise level and align decision making to our key business principles of scalability, resilience, captivity etc.
  - Deliver on time & on budget (always)
Must-have requirements:
  - Bachelor's Degree: Information Technology
Location: Johannesburg
Team notes: CIO, business product owners, CTO, CSO, squads, chapter & guild leads
Employment equity statement: Absa is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from suitably qualified individuals from diverse backgrounds. In support of our Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) commitments and Employment Equity objectives, preference may be given to candidates from underrepresented designated groups, including persons with disabilities.
Accessibility statement: We encourage applicants who may require reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process to let us know so that appropriate support can be provided.
Note: the ad will be published on a job board with its own Apply button.

Lead Technology

Absa Group

Johannesburg

About us
Empowering Africa's tomorrow, together…one story at a time. With over 100 years of rich history and strongly positioned as a local bank with regional and international expertise, a career with our family offers the opportunity to be part of this exciting growth journey, to reset our future and shape our destiny as a proudly African group.

About the role
You will lead the agile solution design, deployment and ongoing optimisation of enterprise-wide technology products and services in low complexity environments. This is a full stack engineering and ownership role: you carry one-stop-shop accountability from ideation through to deployment, including the risk that comes with technical decisions.

Your team
You work with the CIO and business product owners, partner with the CTO, CSO, systems engineering, risk and broader enablement functions, and engage chapter and guild leads. You lead and coach squads.

What you'll do
• Work with the CIO and business product owners to define the end-to-end product and technical strategy
• Act as the single point of partnership for the senior business interface (product owner) relationship, and build product owner technical capability for balanced decision making
• Lead the design of product and service solution blueprints aligned to the organisation's short, medium and long term strategy, applying design thinking practices
• Lead detailed scoping, prioritisation and integration planning across front end, back end and integration stakeholder groups
• Make sure solutions align to Group Architecture and Group Infrastructure standards, including OLAs, IaaS, PaaS, SaaS and containerisation
• Monitor the performance of all applications bank wide, driving ongoing optimisation and cost to value
• Design and implement automation testing, continuous integration and continuous delivery strategies and frameworks across squads, using tools such as Kubernetes, Jenkins, TeamCity, Artifactory, MS PowerShell, CLM tools and APM tools such as New Relic and Splunk
• Make sure designs deliver on self-service, repeatability, testability, scalability and resilience, and deploy via pipeline rather than manually
• Guide code development practices across squads, covering concepts such as threading, parallel processing, asynchronous programming, domain driven design and lambdas
• Manage the DevOps pipeline and associated releases for maximum customer impact and minimum business risk
• Coach and mentor senior developers across squads on the technical competencies needed to deliver DevOps solutions
• Resource and manage squad based teams for both Run and Change delivery, and sustain agile practices such as retrospectives
• Attract, develop, retain and deploy a diverse resource base, and drive performance management aligned with agile sprint routines
• Apply the organisation's risk and governance frameworks, and involve chapter and guild leads in product and infrastructure decisions
• Manage vendor selection processes, negotiate enterprise-level contracts and carry accountability for the related commercial impact
• Deliver on time and on budget

What you need
• Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology
• Expert level knowledge of architecture and infrastructure, including virtualisation, containerisation, automation, storage and serverless technologies such as AWS, Azure, Google and on-prem cloud
• Coding language expertise, for example Java, C++, Groovy, Python, Bash, Perl or Ruby, so you can guide development quality across squads
• Development experience across server side, client side, web (SOAP, REST, JSON), socket based programming, batch and real time, architectural patterns and security domains
• Fluency in deploying agile methodologies across squad based teams

We encourage applicants who may require reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process to let us know so that appropriate support can be provided.

Absa is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from suitably qualified individuals from diverse backgrounds. In support of our Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) commitments and Employment Equity objectives, preference may be given to candidates from underrepresented designated groups, including persons with disabilities.
